Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Fix: in the Pairing card, long animation and option names now wrap, and the play buttons for your half of your partner's pick move to a new line instead of running off the edge.
- Button rows elsewhere (Animations list, Preset Library) also wrap in narrow windows.
